title: Report submitted by the Commission (1951)
text:
Reservations to Multilateral Conventions
Report of the International Law Commission
1951
Adopted by the International Law Commission at its third session, in 1951, and
submitted to the General Assembly as a part of the Commission’s report covering the
work of that session (at para. 12). The report appears in Yearbook of the International
Law Commission, 1951, vol. II.
